Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Zimbabwe players make their way out to the middle, followed by Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das. Blessing Muzarabani will start with the ball.

The target is not a big one and the wicket also seems a decent one to bat on. There is something in it for the bowlers but still there should be value for good strokes. If Bangladesh bat sensibly, they can easily win the series with a game to go. Zimbabwe bowlers will have to step up, they need early wickets. Will they get it? We will find out as the chase begins in a while.

Bangladesh will be pleased with their effort. All their frontline bowlers had a wicket at least to their name. Shoriful Islam though was the pick. He was good at the start and excellent at the end. Shakib Al Hasan too bowled with control. Mohammad Saifuddin was towards the expensive side but the others covered up for him.

So Zimbabwe have crawled their way to 240! Enough? Maybe not! One feels they are around 20 or 30 short of what they would have loved to be. Wickets at regular intervals was their problems, quite a few of them got off to starts but none of them went onto make most of it. All 4 of their middle order batters got past the 20-run mark but just one of them went past 50. Actually, Taylor's wicket was the change in momentum. When he was batting Zimbabwe were all set to score something above 250, he too looked set for a big score but once he fell, the runs slowed down and towards the end, after Wesley Madhevere fell after crossing his half ton, the lower-order did not contribute a lot.
So, just a single of the last ball! A full ball outside off. Ngarava pushes it to deep cover for a single. ZIMBABWE END AT 240 FOR 9.
Fuller ball outside off. Chatara manages toe end on the off side for a single.
Dot ball! Fuller ball way outside off. Chatara swings and misses.
Short of a length ball on middle. Pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! EDGY RUNS! A full ball on middle. Ngarava looks to go big but manages an inside edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
Outside off, on a length. Chatara pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Now a slower ball, on a fuller length, outside off. Ngarava gets deceived as he looks to heave it. Can Zimbabwe finish on a high?
A pacy bouncer from Islam and Ngarava misses his pull completely.
A length ball outside off. Chatara steers it to third man for a single.
A short ball on middle. Ngarava pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, flicked to square leg for a single. There was another single available but Ngarava denies it.
Around off, Tendai Chatara blocks it out.
Yorker on middle. Richard Ngarava digs it out.
Richard Ngarava is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Sikandar Raza departs and also the hopes of Zimbabwe of reaching a score around 250 with him. Shortish ball outside off, Raza looks to cut but gets an inside edge back to Liton Das who takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Liton Das b Mohammad Saifuddin

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Good shot! Full and outside off. Raza drives it through covers for a boundary.
Around off, on a length. Kept out.
FOUR! Innovative! A short ball, slower and on middle. Raza swivels across and paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Yorker on middle. Raza digs it out in time. More pressure on his shoulders now.
Tendai Chatara comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT by Liton Das! Another one bites the dust and Shoriful Islam gets his fourth wicket. A pacy short ball on middle. Blessing Muzarabani goes for the pull but manages a top edge, high in the air and towards Liton Das who takes it easily. Can Bangladesh reach 250?
Commentary.Howout: c Liton Das b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: A back of a length ball, on middle. Blessing Muzarabani mistimes his pull back on the pitch.
A good length ball, on off. Raza pushes it to covers for a single.
Blessing Muzarabani is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another terrific catch in the deep by a Bangladesh player. Islam changes his length this time and goes for a full toss, around knee. Jongwe heaves it, does not time it well. Hits it towards deep mid-wicket where Mosaddek Hossain charges forward and takes it brilliantly. Bangladesh are now 7 down.
Commentary.Howout: c Mosaddek Hossain b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: A pacy short ball on middle. Luke Jongwe gets low to pull it but again fails to connect it.
A back of a length ball, slower and outside off. Luke Jongwe pulls it but fails to connect any bat on it.
Full ball on off. Pushed to covers for a single. 10 runs coming of this over.
FOUR! Well played! A short of a length ball, outside off. Jongwe stands tall, opens the face of his blade and slices it past point for four.
A length ball outside off. Raza pushes it in between short third man and backward point. A slight fumble in the deep and the batters take a couple.
A short ball on middle. Raza hops and pulls it in front of square leg for one.
Beautiful delivery! Yorker on middle. Jongwe jams it out to covers for a single.
A slower full ball on middle. Raza dabs it to backward point for a single.
Keeps strike now as he pushes this one down to long off for one. End of a terrific over by Islam.
The idea was right but it did not come off. Outside off, Raza looks to guide it past short third man but the ball is a little too close to play that shot. He is beaten.
Raza probably misses out there! This is full and outside off, it is hit hard but to covers. A little to his left or right would have been a boundary.
Who will come out to bat now? Luke Jongwe it is.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a superb catch from Tamim! Important one too as it was of the well-set Wesley Madhevere. He was really looking to go after the bowlers in the last few overs and hardly timed any of the shots he tried to hit hard. Fails to do so yet again and now is walking back. Length and outside off, there is a little extra bounce. Madhevere looks to go over long off but there is no timing on that one. Tamim runs in quickly, dives forward and takes it brilliantly.
Commentary.Howout: c Tamim Iqbal b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Another single! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, Raza plays it back to the bowler. One more dot.
A dot to end! Full and on middle, Madhevere looks to hit it through covers but finds the fielder there.
Another single, this time it is fuller and on the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
WIDE! Short but very short. It goes above the head of the batter. Wided.
Goes wide this time and it is bowled outside off, WM cuts it through point for one.
Another single! Bowls short again, wants the batter to hit to the longer sides of the ground, it is cut through point for one.
A short one, it is smacked towards deep mid-wicket for another run.
NIcely hit but for one! Short and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
A dot to end Shakib's spell! 10-0-42-2 for him. On middle, this is pushed to covers with the turn.
A single! On middle, this is pushed down to long off for one.
He had to get bat on that one. On middle, Madhevere looks to sweep but it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
WIDE! Shakib probably felt the batter is going to step out so fires it well wide outside off. Wesley stays in his crease and lets it go. 200 up for Zimbabwe.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Drop and run! On off, Raza pushes it towards cover for one.

A wild hack! Probably not a good idea against Shakib who is bowling his last over. Looks to play the slog sweep, Shakib bowls it slow and outside off. It goes off the inner half towards long on for one.
Another single to end a good over for the host! On middle, this is nudged towards mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on the pads, this is flicked through square leg for one. Raza happy to play sensible cricket. 50-run stand between this two.
Looks to be audacious! Tries to play the reverse sweep but it hits the pad and goes on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Raza takes one now as he pushes this one through covers.
He has probably decided to step on the gas but needs to be careful, still quite some overs to go. He lofts it again over covers, this time long off runs to his left and keeps it down to one.

FOUR! That is a lovely shot! Makes room and this is bowled full and around middle, this is lifted over covers for a welcome boundary! Fifty for Madhevere. A really good innings so far. Walked out when his side was in a spot of bother but has played really well so far. Would want to make this count now.
A tidy over to begin Powerplay 3 then! On off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on middle, this is whipped down to long on for another single.
Angled into the pads, Raza works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
On middle, defended nicely.
Tossed up on off, Raza plays it late and to short third man.
Works this now with the angle towards mid-wicket for one.
Time for Powerplay 3. Now, 5 fielders can be stationed outside the ring till the end of the innings. Also, Shakib Al Hasan is back into the attack.
On off, kept out.
Flatter on middle, Raza punches it to long on for one.
Floated on middle, WM flicks it to mid-wicket.
Shorter on middle, Raza nudges it down to long on for a single.
On middle, tucked to square leg.
WIDE! Down the leg side, left alone by Raza. Wided.
Flatter on the pads, Madhevere works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Mehidy Hasan is back into the attack.
Good length ball outside off, Raza slashes it towards backward point for a couple of runs.
Full on off, Madhevere defends it to point for a single.
Good length ball on off, Raza taps it to point for one.
Short ball outside off, Raza looks to pull but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Raza guides it to short third man.
Full on middle, Raza pushes it to mid off.
Shoriful Islam is back into the attack.
Flatter on off, cut to point for one.
Flighted on middle, Madhevere works it to square leg for a single.
SIX! What a shot is that! Floated on off, Madhevere dances down the track and then lifts it over long off for a maximum.
On off, pushed to the off side.
Loopy ball on off, Madhevere dances down the track and then drives it through mid off for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball outside off, Raza punches it to deep cover for one.
Afif Hossain is into the attack.
Floated on middle, Madhevere flicks it to the leg side.
Flatter on the pads, SR tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Full on off, Raza pushes it to point.
On middle, worked to the leg side for a single.
Flatter on middle, Wesley nudges it to mid-wicket.
Flatter on off, Raza works it down to long on for one.
Mehidy Hasan is back into the attack. Good to see Hasan back after hurting himself on the hand.
Short ball outside off, Madhevere sways away from it.
Low full toss on off, Wesley pushes it to mid off.
Outside off, punched to cover.
Full on middle and leg, Madhevere looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested.
FOUR! Cracking shot from Madhevere! Good length ball outside off, Madhevere drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short ball on middle, Madhevere pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, Raza pushes it to sweeper cover for a single. Sikandar Raza is off the mark.
Another flatter ball on middle. Raza defends it off the front foot.
Flatter ball on middle. Raza defends it out.
Tossed up on off. Raza pushes it to mid off.
Full on middle. Wesley Madhevere pushes it to long on for one.
A length ball on off. Raza hops and taps it to cover. The fielder does well to stop it.
A short of a length ball outside off. Raza sways away from it.
SWING AND A MISS!  A good length ball outside off. Raza looks to cut but gets beaten on the outside edge.
TAP AND RUN! Another full ball on middle. Wesley Madhevere pushes it to the left of mid on and scampers through for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Placement! A full ball around off. Wesley Madhevere leans into his drive and creams it through covers for a boundary. Lovely strike.
Full and outside off. Wesley steps out and pushes it to covers for a single.
Sikandar Raza is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust and guess who, it is Shakib Al Hasan who strikes again. A short ball on middle. Myers rocks back and looked to heave it over mid-wicket but hits it with the upper half of his blade towards long on. Mahmudullah there runs to his right and takes it. He got a lot straighter than he would have liked. He was probably hurried onto the shot there. Myers will be disappointed he walks back after getting off to a start but that has been the case for Zimbabwe so far in this innings.
Commentary.Howout: c Mahmudullah b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! A flatter ball outside off. Myers looks to cut but misses.
Flatter on middle. Blocked out solidly.
A loopy ball on middle. Wesley Madhevere punches it off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, pushed to point for a quick single.

DRINKS! Bangladesh probably just ahead at the moment! However, this partnership is going along decently but can they keep going is the question! This has been the issue for Zimbabwe here, they have got starts but have not gone onto convert it into something significant. Can they do it here or will the visitors continue to dominate?
Single to end the over as this is nudged on the leg side.
Flatter on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Darted on the pads. Flicked on the leg side for another single.
On middle. Myers flicks it to square leg for one.
Bowls a fuller ball outside off. Myers cuts it past point for a couple of runs.
Short ball on middle. Punched back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off. Myers drives it through covers for a brace.

BYE! How has that missed the stumps? A fuller ball, just around off. Wesley Madhevere looks to defend in the line but misses it completely. The ball whizzes past the outside edge. The keeper fails to collect and a bye is taken.
Flatter outside off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for Zimbabwe! Angles another one on middle. Wesley Madhevere paddle sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter on middle. Wesley Madhevere defends it on the leg side.
Angles in on a full length, on middle, stays a bit low as well. Myers tucks it to square leg for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan is back into the attack.
Flighted on middle, Myers works it to deep square leg for one.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Shortish and outside off, Madhevere looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge to short third man where it falls short. A run taken.
Flatter ball outside off, Madhevere cuts it to point.

Mehidy Hasan has hurt himself as he collects the ball. The physios are out and he has been taken back to the hut. He was bleeding and it is also his bowling arm. Not good, his hand was jammed between the ball and the bat of the non-striker. Mosaddek Hossain will continue the over.
Flatter on middle, Madhevere plays it back to the bowler and Mehidy Hasan seems to have hurt himself.
Flatter on middle, Myers works it to deep square leg for one.
Full on middle, WM pushes it back to the bowler.
Full on middle, Myers drives it to mid on and takes a run.
Good length ball on off, Wesley pushes it to mid off for one.
Fullish ball on middle, Madhevere works it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off, punched to cover off the back foot.
Full on middle, Madhevere defends it back to the bowler.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back into the attack. His figures 5-0-20-0.
On off, driven to long off for a single.
Flighted ball on middle, Myers paddles it to fine leg for three more.
Well fielded! Tossed up on the pads, Madhevere flicks it to the fine leg region. The fielder comes charging across, dives and saves a run for his side.
Full on middle, Madhevere uses his feet and plays it to mid-wicket.
Flatter on middle, punched down to long on for one.
Flatter on middle, Myers works it to square leg.
Good length ball on off, Madhevere looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Taskin appeals but the umpire is not interested.
Good length ball outside off, Madhevere looks to punch it off the back foot but misses.
Good length ball on middle, Dion works it to deep square leg for a single.
On off, pushed to point.
BEATEN! Excellent delivery from Taskin Ahmed! Good length ball around off, Myers looks to defend but gets cut in half as the ball goes in between the bat and the pads.
Full outside off, Madhevere drives it to deep cover for a single.
Taskin Ahmed is back into the attack. His figures till now read 7-0-23-1.
Quicker ball on off, Myers defends it out onto the pitch.
On middle, nudged to the leg side for one.
Tossed up on middle, Madhevere uses his feet and then pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker ball on middle, Wesley plays it back to the bowler.
Flatter on middle, Myers punches it down to long on for one.
Floated on middle, Myers defends it out.
A full ball, on middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
Wesley is off the mark as this is pushed to mid on for one.
Another one on the stumps, it is kept out nicely.
On middle, defended.
Wesley Madhevere is the next man in.
Is Brendan Taylor hit-wicket? It seems that Taylor hit the stumps with the bat and the replays show that he has.

OUT! HE HAS KNOCKED THE BAILS OFF! That is quite careless more than unfortunate by Taylor! He can't believe it. He was playing so well and walks back in one of the wierdest ways. A short one and on middle, Taylor lets it go to the keeper. It seems like it is a dot ball but all of a sudden there is an appeal as the bails have been knocked off the grid. It is taken upstairs and replays show that he did knock it off. He was shadow practicing the pull shot after leaving it but he ended up hitting the stumps on his followthrough. Very lazy from him. Huge wicket for Bangladesh and just as a partnership was building it has been broken. This has been the norm for this innings so far.

FOUR! Just over! That has been forced and hence, it was not right off the middle. It is a length ball around off, Taylor stands tall and lofts it towards mid on. The fielder stands and then looks to leap but it goes over.
Shorter in length and on middle, Taylor pushes it down to mid on for one more. So five singles from the over then.
Shorter and on middle, Myers pushes it to the left of mid-wicket, he dives to make a half stop but the single is taken.
Doing it in singles at the moment! On the pads, it is nudged towards square leg.
Slightly shorter this time, Myers pushes it to long on and takes one.
On the pads, this is flicked but to square leg.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Another one on a length and around off, Myers plays it to the man at point.
Mehidy Hasan is back on. 1-0-3-1 are his figures so far.
WIDE! Short but down the leg side. Wided.
Just the one! On the pads, this is worked towards backward square leg for one.
Nicely guided and the 100 is up for Zimbabwe! Shorter and outside off, it is played past point for two.
Takes one now as this is nudged on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length and angling into the middle pole, Myers looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early, a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to the man at covers.
Shoriful Islam is back on.
Angled into the pads, this is worked wide of mid on for one.
Another short one and on middle, Myers evades it.
Slashes and misses! This one zips through! Short and outside off, Myers looks to cut but is beaten for pace.
Another one on the shorter side, Myers leaves it alone again.
Short but outside off, left alone.
Two more! Fuller and on off, Myers strokes it nicely through covers. It does not go all the way as it is the longer part of the ground. Two taken.
Angled into the pads, Myers nudges it through square leg and a run is taken again.
Back of a length and on off, Myers keeps it out nicely.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
FOUR! Finds the gap beautifully! Welcome boundary! On a length and around off, this is driven nicely through covers. It races away to the fence.
Another one on a length and around off, blocked.
Good length and on off, Myers keeps it out.
Just a single of this over then! A length ball around off. Myers punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A short ball, around off. Myers sways away from it.
Drags his length back a bit, outside off. Myers punches it to the point fielder.
Touch fuller on off. Myers defends it to the off side.
Another length ball way outside off. Shouldered arms to it.
Length ball way outside off. Myers lets it through to the keeper.
Another full ball on off. Taylor blocks it out on the off side.
Full ball on off. Taylor pushes it to covers.

LEG BYE! Appeal for LBW but turned down! A length ball, angling down. Myers looks to flick but misses gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls over and they take a leg bye. Was clearly missing the leg stump.
TAP AND RUN! A full ball on middle. Taylor pushes it wide of mid-wicket. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
On a length, on off. Taylor blocks it out on the off side.
A good length ball on off. Taylor defends it out.
On middle. Solidly blocked out by Myers.
A loopy ball outside off. Taylor pushes it to the off side for a single.
Another full ball on middle. Myers pushes it to long on for another single.
Full on middle. Pushed to mid on.
Loopy ball on middle. Taylor works it down to long on for a single.

Flatter ball angling on middle and leg. Taylor prods forward to defend but misses it, gets hit on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan appeals but the umpire is not interested. Probably drifting down the leg side.
A good length ball on middle. Myers blocks it out on the deck.
Full ball around off. Taylor works it down to long on for a single.
A short of a length ball on middle. Taylor blocks it on the leg side.
A good length ball, on middle. Myers dabs it to third man for one.
A length ball, on off. Pushed to covers.
A good length ball, on middle. Myers pushes it back to the bowler.  Saifuddin falls on his follow-through.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back into the attack.
Floated ball around off. Taylor defends it out.
Flatter ball on middle. Myers punches off the back foot to long on for a single. Dion Myers is underway.
Dion Myers is the next man in.

Drinks! Zimbabwe were looking good but the wicket of Regis Chakabvas has pegged them back now. Brendan Taylor though is looking very good but he now will need support from the rest of the batsmen to take Zimbabwe to a good score. Bangladesh, on the other hand, need to continue picking up wickets. They have bowled really well so far and now would look to restrict Zimbabwe.

OUT! TIMBER! Shakib Al Hasan strikes and he gets his first wicket of the game! A tossed up ball, around leg, spins away from Chakabva. Regis Chakabva looks to push it but fails to connect any bat on it. The ball rolls through and hits the stumps. Zimbabwe are now 3 down and in a spot of bother.
Tossed up on middle. Taylor flicks it to square leg for a single.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR BYES! Misses everyone! Angles it on a fuller length, around leg. Chakabva looks to push but misses it. The keeper fails to collect it and the ball races away to the fence.
A good length ball, slanting across, outside off. Taylor shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! Good shot! A good length ball, outside off. Taylor whacks it not quite off the middle but well enough for the ball to race away to the deep mid-wicket fence.
A length ball, on off. Kept out watchfully.
FOUR! Well played! A back of a length ball, angling on middle. Taylor swivels across and pulls it towards fine leg fence for a boundary.
A length ball, around off. Taylor defends it on the off side.
A good length ball, on off. Chakabva taps it to third man for a single.
Full on middle, BT defends it to mid on.
Floated on the pads, Taylor looks to play the reverse sweep but it goes off the pads to the leg side.
Floated on middle, Taylor nudges it to mid-wicket.
On middle, worked to long on for one.
Tossed up outside off, Taylor drives it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Taylor works it to short fine leg.
Length ball on off, Chakabva defends it to point.
Shortish on the pads, Taylor clips it to deep square leg for one.
Good length ball on off, Taylor defends it to mid off.
Short ball outside off, Taylor looks to play the upper cut but misses.
Full on off, Taylor pushes it to cover off the front foot.
Good length ball on the pads, Chakabva works it to deep square leg for one.
BEATEN! Beautifully bowled by Shakib Al Hasan! Floated outside off, Taylor looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge. Liton Das appeals for a caught behind but the umpire is not interested.
Tossed up on off, Taylor chips it over extra cover for a couple.
Flighted on off, Taylor blocks it to point.
Floated on off, Chakabva drives it to long off for a single.
Loopy ball on the pads, Taylor clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Floated on middle, Taylor pushes it back to the bowler.
A short one and it angled from the off pole, left alone.
Now works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Outside off, left alone.
SIX! Over the fence! That is a brilliant shot! On middle, Taylor whips it, it goes over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 10 from the first two balls, pressure on the bowler now.
FOUR! Put away! Fifty up for Taylor! Full and outside off, Taylor drives it through cover and it races away to the fence.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders can be stationed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Shoriful Islam has a change of ends.
A single to end Powerplay 1 and it is a decent one for the hosts! They are 46 for 2 after it. On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
FOUR! That is really nicely played! A little too full, Taylor lofts it over the bowler's head and bags a boundary. Welcome boundary and the first for Taylor.
Angled into the pasd, Regis nudges it throughs square leg for one.
A single as Taylor skips out and works it through square leg for one.
On the stumps, blocked.
Shorter and on off, Regis pushes it down to long off for one.
Shakib Al Hasan is into the attack.
A lucky escape for Taylor! That was very fortunate. Back of a length ball and on middle, Taylor looks to defend but he slips in the process. The boot comes off but it lands just ahead of the stumps.
Another one on a length and around off, Taylor pushes it to covers.
Back of a length and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
In the air... safe! A short one and on middle, it gets big on the batter. Chakabva looks to pull but it goes off the top edge, it lands safe in the mid-wicket region for one.
Outside off, left alone.
Angled into the middle pole, Chakabva works it towards mid-wicket.
A short one and on middle, Taylor stands tall and defends it onto the ground,. A tidy start by Islam.
Back of a length and on off, Taylor pushes it to covers.
Another single! On the body, this is clipped towards fine leg for one more run.
Taylor is off the mark! On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
Angled into the pads, Chakabva works it down to fine leg for one.
On the off pole, defended nicely.
Shoriful Islam is on.

A huge, huge appeal but turned down! Probably a little too high! Really good from Taskin! After two short balls, he goes slightly fuller, this one tails back in late. Taylor looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. An appeal but turned down. Taylor was rooted to his crease there, probably expecting another short one. There was actually an inside edge. Replays confirm there was no inside edge, there were two sounds but not sure of what.
Another short one, this one does not bounce as high as the last one, blocked onto the ground.
A good short one! It rises on the batter. Taylor, hops and defends it onto the ground.
Angled into the pads, Chakabva works it down to fine leg and takes one.
Not the right shot! This is just outside off, too short to cut. Chakabva slashes at it, it hits the glove and goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Slightly shorter in length and around off, Chakabva looks to pull but it goes off the inside edge towards square leg.
Full on off, Taylor defends it to cover.
Brendan Taylor is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Poor, poor shot from Marumani and Mehidy Hasan strikes. Marumani was let off in the last over but he does not make use of the opportunity. Tossed up on middle, Marumani looks to swing it away but misses and the ball uproots the off stump.
Shortish on middle, Chakabva works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, Chakabva nudges it to mid on.
Flighted on the pads, Chakabva works it to the deep on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Mehidy Hasan is into the attack.

Good length ball outside off, Kamunhukamwe slaps it but does not keep it down and it goes to Afif Hossain at point who does not make a mistake. Perfect start from Bangladesh.

We are all set to begin the second ODI! The Bangladesh players stride out to the middle, followed by the openers of Zimbabwe, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe and Tadiwanashe Marumani. Taskin Ahmed will start with the ball.

Tamim Iqbal, the Bangladesh skipper, says that it is a good toss to lose and he does not mind bowling. Adds that the pitch looks sticky. Tells that they need to have a plan. Adds that they are playing the same side.

Brendan Taylor, the Zimbabwe skipper says that they will bat first. Goes onto say that there is not much grass on the pitch and they can play with freedom. Adds that they started the innings well in the first game but they were poor after that. Tells that they need to improve. Informs that they have made 2 changes as Ryan Burl and Timycen Maruma are injured and Sikandar Raza and Tinashe Kamunhukamwe come in.

Pitch report - Athar Ali Khan is there for the pitch report. He says that the pitch is a new one and there are some cracks near the good length area. Tells that the pitch will play similar to the first game and the ball might do quite a bit in the first hour. Adds that there will be side movement and the batters will have to be careful.

Afif Hossain is there for a chat. He says that they adapted to the conditions well. Adds that he was feeling comfortable and he was trying to rotate the strike. Goes onto say that he was disappointed to get out. Tells that they are feeling comfortable in this situation and they will look to continue the performance. Goes onto say that they want to stick to their plans.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Wesley Madhevere, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Brendan Taylor (C), Dion Myers, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe (IN PLACE OF TIMYCEN MARUMA), Regis Chakabva (WK), Sikandar Raza (IN PLACE OF RYAN BURL), Luke Jongwe, Tendai Chatara, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Bangladesh (Unchanged Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das (WK), Mohammad Mithun, Mosaddek Hossain, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah, Mehidy Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Afif Hossain, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of Zimbabwe. They have elected to bat first.

Liton Das has made a serious impact as an opener for Bangladesh. He played the anchor role in the first ODI as Bangladesh had lost early wickets and they needed someone to stay out there and play till the end. Liton Das did just that as he started off slowly, got his first boundary very late and when it was time to attack, he did and scored a fine, fine century. He would look to continue doing the same in this series and his form is a good sign for the visitors.

Zimbabwe have certainly missed Sean Williams and Craig Ervine, haven't they? In the one-off Test, Zimbabwe's middle order struggled and both Williams and Ervine were missed a lot. Even in the first ODI, Zimbabwe needed them as their experience could have come in handy but with them missing in action, a lot of pressure is built on Brendan Taylor. They have Sikandar Raza back as well but he did not get to play in the first ODI. It will be interesting to see if he makes an appearance in this game.

It is time for round 2 in the 3-match ODI series between Zimbabwe and Bangladesh. Bangladesh continued their dominance in the series from the one-off Test and then the first ODI where they defeated Zimbabwe by 155 runs. They certainly look the favourites to win this game as well and the series with a game to spare but Zimbabwe can surprise one and all as they are known to punch above their weight but then again, it won't be easy for them against an in-form line-up of Bangladesh. Will Bangladeh be able to win the series with one game to spare or will Zimbabwe level the series? We will find out.
